My name is Ayush Debnath. I am a fourth year undergraduate student. I have been contributing to google deepmind formal-conjectures for a time being and have been doing Erdos Problems. I want to start a full scale project with guidance and want to connect with people. My strengths are probability and statistics, graph theory, numerical methods and calculaus and linear algebra along with coordinate geometry.
Please let me know if I can contribute to a project.
@Yaël Dillies has been very helpful to me in guiding and merging my PRs.
